title: Per-run manifest (runs/<run-id>/run.json)
description: Written by the runner (owner: the runner task, T14/T16 - DESIGN.md 4.12). Frozen input to the report generator: Beads alone cannot reconstruct report statuses, because stuck/tampered/failed all map to 'blocked' and done/partial both map to 'closed'.

concurrency.description: How many task containers this runner was configured to work at once (DESIGN.md 7). The configured or defaulted setting, not the observed peak in flight. Optional: manifests written before the knob existed carry no such field.

allowHalfProven.description: Whether this run admitted a frozen suite whose freeze receipt records a 'half-proven' verdict - red at the fork point with no probe supplied (DESIGN.md 4.12's third admission rule, change-log row `repo-isq`). The effective setting, defaulted to false. Recorded because it changes which tasks were ELIGIBLE, so two runs over the same queue are not comparable without it. Optional: manifests written before the rule existed carry no such field.

feed.description: The live queue feed (DESIGN.md 4.12, change-log row `live-queue-feed`). Present on every manifest written since the feed shipped, whether or not it was enabled; absent means a manifest written before it existed. When enabled is false the run read its roster once at startup - the pre-feed behaviour, and the default. When true the run re-read the ready queue while in flight, so 'tasks' is in DISPATCH order and its length is not knowable from the startup queue-summary line.

idleGraceMinutes.description: How long the run stays up with nothing to do before closing out. 0 means the feed is off.

polls.description: How many times the ready queue was re-read. A run whose workers were never idle re-reads zero times.

ending.description: Why the run stopped taking work. 'drained' = the roster was spent, which is always the answer when the feed is off; 'idle' = the grace window expired with nothing new; 'stopped' = the runs/<run-id>/stop sentinel appeared; 'halted' = the run-level rate-limit cap fired, so nothing further could be launched.

abortedReason.description: Present when the run ended before draining the queue (preflight failure, operator stop).

outcome.description: Report status from the 4.11 table. 'undispatchable' is the one value that touches Beads not at all: the ready queue refused the issue before claim() because its frozen acceptance suite is absent from the branch its container would fork from (4.12), so it stays open.

refusal.description: Why the ready queue refused this issue, present only on an 'undispatchable' row (DESIGN.md 4.12). 'no-suite' = no frozen acceptance suite on the integration branch; 'no-receipt' = a suite the freeze gate never blessed, or a receipt that is unparseable, of an unknown version or of an unknown verdict; 'receipt-mismatch' = the suite changed after the gate passed; 'half-proven' = the gate saw it red with no probe, and this run did not set allowHalfProven. Absent on a row written before the third admission rule existed, which renders as 'no-suite'.

exitCode.description: Container exit code, or 'killed' for a host wall-clock kill (which produces no code).

diffLines.description: Lines changed on the branch - the report's tie-breaker after attempt count.

model.description: Model the agent phases ran on (4.3).

specConcerns.description: Verbatim copy of the container's status-file specConcerns (DESIGN.md 3.7), carried so the report and PR body can surface them. Same bounds as status.schema.json. Evidence only (3.5): present or absent, it never affects outcome or scrutiny order.
